meta.title: About Us
meta.description: Company profile, vision and mission, legal credentials, leadership, and locations of PT Sarana Piranti Energi.

narrative.heading: Company Profile
narrative.body: Starting from PT Step Point Indonesia, experienced in the fields of Contracting, Information Technology, Networking and Mechanical & Electrical, collaborating with experienced practitioners in the Gas industry covering engineering, sales, and investment — in early 2023 we established a company operating in the Gas sector and related fields: PT Sarana Piranti Energi. We have long supported Oil & Gas companies as investors and contractors in product trading, facility maintenance, and facility construction. Today, we are directly involved in this business — in sales, production, and development — with plans to begin building LPG and CNG processing facilities in the future.

visionMission.heading: Vision & Mission
visionMission.visionText: To become the best company in the Oil & Gas field and its management.
visionMission.missionText: To continuously improve service and high productivity in all activities.

items.title: Company Established
items.body: PT Sarana Piranti Energi was officially established via Notarial Deed No. 1 on 13 February 2023, born from the synergy between PT Step Point Indonesia and national gas-industry practitioners.

items.title: NIB Registration
items.body: The Business Identification Number (NIB) was issued through the OSS-RBA system of the Ministry of Investment/BKPM, marking the start of official company operations.

items.title: Oil & Gas Trading License
items.body: Obtained an Oil & Gas Trading Business License from the Ministry of Investment and Downstream/BKPM, valid until 10 September 2027.

items.title: LPG & CNG Processing Plans
items.body: SPE plans to build LPG and CNG processing facilities to expand its business portfolio from trading into production.
